PV Sindhu Wins Japan Open, Breaks Win Drought

Indian badminton player PV Sindhu has won the Japan Open title. She defeated China's Chen Yufei in the final, breaking a streak of five consecutive losses against her. This victory marks Sindhu's first major title in seven years and ends a 19-month winless period. Sindhu stated that the win boosted her confidence and proved her journey is not over.
